text: [101] pañcime bhikkhave sekhavesārajjakaraṇā dhammā katame pañca idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti . yaṃ kho 1 bhikkhave assaddhassa sārajjaṃ hoti saddhassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo . yaṃ bhikkhave dussīlassa sārajjaṃ hoti sīlavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo . yaṃ bhikkhave appassutassa sārajjaṃ hoti bahussutassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo . yaṃ bhikkhave kusītassa sārajjaṃ hoti āraddhaviriyassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo . yaṃ bhikkhave duppaññassa sārajjaṃ hoti paññavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo . ime kho bhikkhave pañca sekhavesārajjakaraṇā dhammāti .
